title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：poison　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 poison 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the researcher ① detected the poison that no student in the lab would have noted, and he said the detecting was the whole of the term. The ② poison, meaning the drug itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; poison, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sample of poison in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ poison at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Poison, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the researcher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the poison was the whole of the matter, meaning the harm and not the drug. The ⑥ poison, meaning the harm and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; poison, he said, is either something you detect or the only word that means both drug and a harm. He said the harm is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ poison had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ poison of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of noting; poison, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ poison I remember is the poison noted in the paper, which closed in 1991 and is still noted as the quietest in the lab. ⑩ Poison, my mother said in 1993, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all poison, she said, is a harm that has agreed to look like drug. She said the harm was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 毒；毒物（指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 毒；毒物（指那种毒本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：detect the poison 查出这一种毒
D. n. 毒；毒物（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 毒之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的毒之事）
F. n. 毒；毒物（指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一种）
G. n. 毒、祸害（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 祸害（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: detected the poison that no student in the lab would have noted
The poison, meaning the drug itself and not the tube
Every sample of poison in that lab
the poison at the far bench
the poison was the whole of the matter
the poison had become a line in a paper
The poison of the whole thing

answers.why: detect the poison 意为“查出这一种毒”，1984 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一种毒做了一遍。
poison 意为“毒；毒物”，指那种毒本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
poison 意为“毒；毒物”，指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
poison 意为“毒；毒物”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
poison 意为“毒、祸害”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种祸害就是那件事的全部。
poison 意为“祸害”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种毒，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
poison 意为“毒；毒物”，指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一种，到 1989 年这一种成了研究报告里的一行。
poison 意为“毒之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的毒之事是一处实验室和三个学期的记下。
poison 意为“毒；毒物”，我记得的是研究报告里记下过的那一种，1991 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一种。
poison 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，毒是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的毒。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年那位研究员查出了实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一种毒，他说这一遍才是那个学期的全部。（detect the poison）
那种毒，指的是那种毒本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。（poison）
那处实验室里每一份毒旁边都有同一支细细的试管。（poison）
最远那张实验台那种毒，指的是他们留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（poison）
叔叔说这种祸害就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那种毒。（poison）
1993 年母亲说，毒是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的毒。（poison）

The poison at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
